info.title: Post Engineer API
info.description: Generate and schedule short videos for social accounts. Authenticate with an API key created in the dashboard: Authorization: Bearer <key>.

errors.description: Up to 20 validation problems (generate-and-schedule 400 only). The first entry matches the top-level code, error and field.

auth_url.description: https URL to open in a browser.

422.description: Bluesky rejected the handle or app password (code BLUESKY_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED).
3Speak rejected the username or posting key (code THREESPEAK_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED).

image_url.description: Signed URL; null when signing failed (GET only).

image_url_error.description: true when image_url could not be signed (GET only).

image_url.description: Signed URL; null when signing failed (GET only).

image_url_error.description: true when image_url could not be signed (GET only).

image_url.description: Signed URL; null when signing failed (GET only).

image_url_error.description: true when image_url could not be signed (GET only).

avatarUrl.description: Exactly one of photo or avatarUrl on create.
Exactly one of photo or avatarUrl on create.

body.description: Task record. state: -1 failed, 1 complete, 3 queued, 4 processing.

410.description: Terminal: the engine no longer has this task. Stop polling; GET /api/schedule/slots/{slotId} says whether the video was delivered or failed and refunded.

502.description: Engine unavailable or state unverifiable; retry with backoff.

refunds.description: Token refunds issued for cancelled slots.

get.description: slotId is the slot id returned by generate-and-schedule. The slot post detail fields are returned at the top level next to success.

slots.description: Range mode only: every slot with slot_at in [from, to).

truncated.description: Range mode only: true when the slot cap was hit.

body.description: Task record. state: -1 failed, 1 complete, 3 queued, 4 processing.

post.description: Provider-specific form fields (video file, title, caption) are read by the provider handler; see the MCP publish_video (action: from_file) tool.

413.description: Declared size over the 2GB video limit.

502.description: The signed upload URL could not be created.

post.description: Mint a signed video upload: returns the uploadId, the signedUrl to PUT the video bytes to directly, and the expiry. The upload is bound to the caller and capped at 2GB.

409.description: The upload was already consumed, or changed while being verified.

410.description: The upload expired before completion. Mint a new one.

413.description: The stored video is over the 2GB limit.

post.description: Verify a signed video upload after the PUT: the server checks the real content (magic bytes) and size, then marks it ready. Idempotent for an already-ready upload.

409.description: The upload is not completed yet, or was already used to publish.

410.description: The upload expired before publishing. Mint a new one.

413.description: The stored video is over the 2GB limit.

post.description: Publish a completed signed-upload video by uploadId — the remote replacement for publish_video (action: from_file). Single-use: one publish consumes the upload. Provider field rules mirror publish_video (action: from_file) (YouTube: title, description, tags, privacyStatus; Rumble/Fanvue: title, description; Pinterest: boardId plus description or caption; the rest: caption).

402.description: INSUFFICIENT_TOKENS: the balance does not cover the video.

409.description: PERSONA_ALREADY_SCHEDULED: this persona already has an active schedule.

502.description: The engine did not accept any video (each one refunded); retry with backoff.

personaId.description: Optional: a faceless post needs no persona.

schedule.description: Required when mode is 'scheduled' (the default); forbidden when mode is 'asap'.

fullLipsync.description: Persona talks for the whole video, not only the hook. Not with faceless.

experiment.description: Join a paired A/B experiment: this video is one variant of one pair. Checked before the charge.

404.description: SCHEDULE_NOT_FOUND: a schedule does not exist, is not yours, or has no video.

409.description: BATCH_CONFLICT: a video already belongs to another batch; BATCH_WINDOW_EXCEEDED: the videos were not created within 10 minutes of the first.

segments.description: Segments in order: hook first, then content takes. 60-200 words in total.

fullLipsync.description: Optional. Media is optional when true (full lip sync); otherwise every segment needs a media list, about one image per ~3s, at most 30.

publishCheck.description: null for kind "script": caption limits do not apply to spoken text.

personaId.description: Omit or null for a faceless experiment.
